text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm... The essential oils I used last<n>night were
stronger than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Is the scent lingering in my hair or<n>something? Is
that why people keep<n>looking at me?

text_block_list.name: Dober's Friend
text_block_list.text:
You smell different today. Did you use<n>a new oil or
something?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I knew it. The scent's gotten<n>into my hair!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober is so self-conscious<n>about the smell
that she goes off to<n>train alone, but she does poorly
due<n>to how distracted she is.
